timing: Declared before inspecting target shot-choice results or running any v45 simulation.
design: Add one measured-activity candidate per conditional choice branch at sigma=0.05, alongside the original sigma grid without activity. Feature is training-only blocked shots per on-court opponent branch-trial attempt, smoothed by 200 trial attempts and centered at training league rate; same scale and N(0,1) slope prior as make activity.
selection: Older-three-season whole-game heldout NLL only; target excluded. No direct fitting to observed on/off or player rank. Training activity and heldout trial outcomes never share games. This is predictive structure, not a causal deterrence estimate.
